name: OS Client Certs -- cert9.db cleanup
description: ON-COMPOSE-ERROR-TRIGGER BUILD (v4, dedup fix), not for production: v0.4.28 was observed registering nsIMsgComposeStateListener twice on the same window, so ComposeProcessDone fired twice per real failure -- the retry-loop guard misread the duplicate echo as "the retry already failed", sometimes leaving it stuck and silently skipping a later, genuinely new failure on the same window. This build guards RegisterStateListener itself against double registration, and reworks the retry-tracking flag to always reset instead of ever getting permanently stuck.
